scope: General JNI canonical Class-object references and actual production safe reference/invocation dispatch, not a Class.getClassLoader-specific workaround.

basis.implementation: Independent JNI contract implementation; no JDK/ART implementation source copied.

observed_blocker.result: The unchanged original SDK/NDK proof correctly supplies its static native jclass as a java.lang.Class receiver. Actual dispatch op4 rejects token0x17 as JNI_REFERENCE_KIND before reaching the real shared Class.getClassLoader implementation. Method token0x1b and receiver are preserved in raw diagnostics; failed run returned to launcher and SD restored.

implementation.normalization: Every new production class reference from FindClass, GetObjectClass and static native receivers uses Handle::Object pointing to the existing canonical Engine java.lang.Class heap object. No parallel descriptor-only object identity is created; descriptor-only Handle::Class is no longer emitted by device Session. Upstream handle enum/oracle compatibility is retained.
implementation.class_positions: jclass-consuming operations validate a genuine canonical Class object and recover its represented descriptor. Actual member IDs retain their declaring class/name/signature/static-kind metadata. Genuine Java-returned primitive and array Class objects remain valid in jclass positions; FindClass name admission policy is unchanged.
implementation.object_positions: A Class object passes the same jobject receiver/argument/return resolver as other Java heap objects. Method/field IDs cannot become jobjects or class objects. GetObjectClass on a jclass returns canonical Class.class, and IsInstanceOf uses the shared real type hierarchy rather than interpreting the represented class as the object runtime type.
implementation.references: Actual as-native::jni_refs::References still owns thread-local/global/frame/kind limits and roots. Local/global duplicates refer to one canonical heap identity, wrong-thread/deleted references remain rejected, frame results survive only via valid escaped refs, opaque member IDs are rejected in object operations and report JNIInvalidRefType0 for GetObjectRefType. Null reference type is0.
implementation.shared_execution: The real Session delegates reference operations and invocation decode/execute to the new no_std jni_objects module. Host tests call these exact production functions using the actual References table, actual DEX declarations, actual FrameworkHost and actual GC root traversal. No table borrow survives VM invocation/native callbacks.
implementation.proof_preservation: Existing fixtures/m9/jni-construct Java/NDK proof was not edited. Its previously failed NRO/raw report remains immutable and must be replayed on a new exact NRO.

limits: JNI FindClass still searches the flat current session DEX/builtin classpath; implicit native-caller defining-loader/JNI_OnLoad loader selection and attached-thread bootstrap visibility are not implemented. Java forName/loadClass provenance checks do not establish JNI loader selection.

Complete JNI behavior, weak global references, all Class methods, raw C pointer/varargs transport and class verification are not newly claimed. The bounded explicit method catalog remains authoritative.
Canonical Class metadata remains interned/rooted for the VM lifetime; ordinary object refs are released/collected when their actual JNI/frame/global roots disappear.
Horizon-only Session wiring requires the parent target check/product build, and actual unchanged-proof NRO execution plus physical Switch evidence are separate.
